# Red Rose Technologies LLC

> Red Rose Technologies LLC (redrosetechnologies.com) is an IT, automation and
> cybersecurity firm based in Lakewood Ranch, Florida, serving dental practices,
> healthcare and occupational medicine clinics, legal firms, nonprofits and local
> businesses across Manatee County, Sarasota County and greater Tampa Bay.
> Founded in 2019 by Ron Rose (Founder & CTO). The firm starts by finding where a
> practice loses time and money, then streamlines and automates around how that
> practice actually runs. Red Rose does not publish prices; cost depends on the
> size and setup of the business.

## Contact

- Phone: (941) 206-4709

## How Red Rose works

The method, in this order:

1. Find where the practice is losing time and money. Operational waste first,
   before any talk of technology.
2. Streamline the workflow around what that practice actually does.
3. Automate the parts that should be automated, and leave alone the parts that
   should not.
4. Build all of it around how that practice runs.

Every practice runs differently, so the work is shaped to the practice rather
than sold as a standard package. The aim is to give the team back time and take
cost out so the practice runs leaner. That is the aim, stated as an aim and not
as a promised result.

## Services

- **AI & Automation Clinics** — three live, hands-on sessions where a team builds
  real automations, leaves with a 90 day rollout plan, and gets 30 days of email
  support afterwards.
- **Managed IT & Security** — 24/7 network monitoring, patching, backup, HIPAA
  aware security, cybersecurity and proactive support. No contracts, no hidden
  fees. A free dark web scan is offered.
- **Dental IT Support** — supported platforms include Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open
  Dental and Curve Dental.
- **Occupational Medicine IT Support** — supported platforms include PrognoCIS,
  Net Health, Enterprise Health, Cority and SYSTOC, covering occupational health
  clinics doing employer services, DOT and physical exams, injury case
  management and employee health records.
- **HIPAA Compliance** — security assessments, policies and ongoing compliance
  for healthcare and dental offices.
- **Cloud setup and migration** — including Microsoft 365, and Windows 11
  migration planning with hardware compatibility assessment and phased rollouts.

## Support tiers

Three managed service tiers, with target response times:

- Core Shield — response within 4 hours
- Advanced Guard — response within 2 hours
- Total Command — response within 1 hour, with priority escalation

These are target response times. They are not a guarantee and not a contractual
service level agreement.

## Credentials

Google AI Essentials Certified. CompTIA IT Fundamentals+. HIPAA Security
Specialist. 24/7 SOC monitoring. Red Rose provides HIPAA compliant Business
Associate Agreements (BAAs) for all managed service clients.

## Service area

Lakewood Ranch, Bradenton, Sarasota, Palmetto, Parrish, North Port, Tampa,
Clearwater and St. Petersburg, Florida; Manatee County, Sarasota County and the
greater Tampa Bay area.

## Client-reported results

These are outcomes reported by named clients on the site, not general claims
about what any client will get:

- A dental client reported roughly $75,000 a year in savings after a review of
  spend, a move from Eaglesoft servers to Curve Dental in the cloud, a phone
  system change, and a payroll move from ADP to Gusto.
- A client since 2011 reported an enterprise network built for 115+ staff that
  is still running.
- A legal client reported a vulnerability caught before it became an incident.
